packs.name: Meadow
packs.blurb: Hop from tile to tile. Every tile is visited once.

packs.name: Creek
packs.blurb: Gaps appear: jump over one missing tile. Gold tiles need two visits.

packs.name: Billabong
packs.blurb: Arrow tiles: leave them only the way the triangle points.

packs.name: Ridge
packs.blurb: Arrows and metals: gold on one level, steel on the next.

packs.name: Mesa
packs.blurb: Wide boards where one wrong jump strands you.

packs.name: Plateau
packs.blurb: Everything at once, on a big board.

packs.name: Outback
packs.blurb: The longest walks in the game.
